findings.evidence: Opening customers is a period roll-forward: D5:H5 each link to the preceding month's closing customers, and J5:Z5 continue the same pattern. I5 is the sole hardcoded value (7,900) in the row, resetting month 7 rather than using H9 (9,695). With the downstream J5 error left as stored, this affects month 7 only.

The row must carry each month's closing customers into the next month's opening customers. J5 incorrectly skips I9 and links to H9; K5:Z5 then roll forward from this incorrect opening balance. The impacts are the change from correcting J5 alone against the workbook as stored; correcting I5 as well produces a combined impact of +566,096.0 to P&L!AA15 and +4,678,245.0 to Valuation!B7 versus current outputs.
